The universal container: hairline border, 12px radius, flat by default.

```jsx
<Card padding="compact" elevation={1}>…</Card>
<Card surface="cream">Warm interlude band</Card>
<Card surface="inverse">Featured plan</Card>
```

Shadows stay subtle — `elevation={2}` is reserved for floating panels and product mockups. Cream and inverse surfaces are chromatic punctuation: at most one per screen.
